derived_from.description: Real ebpf.ipsec_state_builder snapshot recorded by the e2e verification parser run; the validated ESP-only IPv4 state.

not_a_capture: This file is NOT a packet capture and not a recording of any real system. It is a derived test input. No PCAP accompanies it, and no evidence reference in the system points at it as a capture.

edits.detail: the substantive change: ESP is no longer the protection in force
the substantive change: AH replaces ESP, so integrity without confidentiality
a consequence of esp_seen, not an independent change: no ESP packet is now observed
a consequence of ah_seen: the observed traffic is now AH
a consequence of the presence change: the recorded SPI is no longer active
a consequence: the same packets now evidence AH traffic, not an active ESP SA

unchanged: endpoints, the observation window, all packet/byte counters, the SPI value itself and its per-SPI counters and sequence arithmetic, and the IPSEC_IPSEC_START transition record are the real recorded values, byte for byte
why: Every real recorded capture in this repository reports the same security posture (IPv4, ESP present, AH absent), so no real pair exercises a protection change. The derivation is declared field by field so the resulting drift is attributable to exactly two booleans.
